## Annual salary to hourly rate
To calculate your hourly rate from an annual salary, divide your annual salary by the number of hours you work in a year.

**Hourly rate** = Annual salary ÷ (Hours per week × Weeks per year)

**Example:** If you earn $50,000 and you work a 40-hour week for 52 weeks per year, your hourly rate calculation would be:

50000 ÷ (40 × 52) = **$24.04 per hour**

![Formula showing how to calculate hourly rate from $60,000 annual salary](https://www.thecalculatorsite.com/images/salary-to-hourly-calculation-example.png)
